Offer disclaimers
Your offer is valid from 27 July 2026, 12:00am until 27 September 2026, 11:59pm AEST / AEDT.
The transaction date is based on your monthly card statement. To be eligible for the offer the transaction must occur between 12:00am on the Start date and 11:59pm on the End date, AEST / AEDT.
Offers are non-transferrable and can only be accepted by the primary cardholder or an additional cardholder using a card linked to the primary cardholder's account.
Offer cashback is limited to 1 card per customer, per retailer.
Cashback details
Cashback offers are credited to your account in the form of money for meeting the spend criteria on specified goods and services.
You will receive the cashback amount as a statement credit on your card account. The cashback amount will normally be paid into your account within 7 business days of processing the eligible transaction. Allow additional days during public holidays or if your card is being replaced.
Cashback is not redeemable for cash, non-refundable and not transferable to additional cardholder’s other Westpac credit cards.
Eligible and ineligible cards
Eligible Westpac credit cards include most Westpac branded consumer credit cards and the Altitude Business credit card and Westpac BusinessChoice credit cards.
Ineligible cards include American Express® Westpac Altitude Platinum Card, American Express® Westpac Black Card, Westpac Commercial credit cards and Westpac Consumer or Business Debit Cards.
General disclaimers
The Westpac Extras program terms and conditions are subject to change. Updated terms will be made available at westpac.com.au/extras .
